meta.title: Mgetbrain · Notes Organizer
meta.description: Installed Cordis bundle: organize 得到大脑/Get笔记 via official OpenAPI. Full-text download into a unified data directory (default: data-getbrain next to the repo, auto-created, never in Git), read-only by default, confirmation-gated writes, double-gated deletion. The Mgetbrain sidebar workbench shows the real knowledge-base → series → book → lecture → highlight hierarchy (rebuilt locally, since official topics are flat) and lets you adjust categories; configure API Key/Client ID/dataDir in Settings → Mgetbrain, applied immediately without restart.
